title: JSON Formatter
h1: JSON Formatter — Validate, Prettify and Minify JSON
seoTitle: Free JSON Formatter & Validator Online | ToolNova
description: Paste JSON to validate it, pretty-print with indentation, or minify it. Instant error messages for invalid input. Runs entirely in your browser.
intro: Validate JSON, format it with readable indentation, or strip whitespace for a compact version. Errors show the exact problem.
blurb: Validate, pretty-print and minify JSON instantly in your browser.
howItWorks: Paste or type JSON into the input box.
Click Format to pretty-print with two-space indentation, Minify to remove all unnecessary whitespace, or Validate to check syntax only.
Invalid JSON shows a clear error message with the approximate location of the problem.
examples: Format a minified API response so it is easy to read.
Minify a configuration file before embedding it in a URL or compact storage.
Validate a JSON payload before sending it to an endpoint.

faq.q: Does it support comments or trailing commas?
faq.a: No. It follows the strict JSON standard, so comments and trailing commas are rejected as invalid.
No. Parsing and formatting happen entirely inside your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
Two spaces. This is a common readable default for JSON.
